== Introduction ==
Season 1 of the Salvation Quakeworld Draft League started in march 2012. The season ended with a victory for Milton's Militia. There was a lot of positive feedback with one major exception. Many players who signed up didn't get to play due to limited slots in the 10 teams.

* '''Website:''' http://draft.quakeworld.nu/season1/
* '''Gametype:''' [[4on4]] Team Deathmatch
* '''Number of teams:''' 10
* '''Structure:''' Draft
* '''Number of playoff teams:''' 8
